activity_summary: You came off dead by the third act and out of the gown by four. Burbage said the yard did not thin. You would not give the side a name on the way home. Kemp spent the name, and you did not offer him a fool in that part. You put the scarf on and left the name on the peg.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Came off, and would not name the side.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Marked him done by the third, and sent him home.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Spent the name, and was not offered a new fool.

facets.activity: Came off dead by the third act, out of the gown by four

quotes.speaker: richard_burbage
quotes.text: Dead by the third, and the gown off by four, and the yard did not thin for the want of thee.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not giving it a name on the way home.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: Sweet Master Shakespeare, out of a gown and into a scarf.
